title: Signed right-slot normalization predicate on the finite tensor tower
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and scheme $W$, and use the completed coefficient modules, ordinary finite reductions, strict total-tensor tower $T(P,Q)$ and its total tensor generators of [def-pur-integral-finite-tensor-tower]. Let $P,Q$ be arbitrary unbounded integral module complexes and $r\in\mathbf Z$, with the cochain shift convention of [def-weil-triangulated-category]. For a supplied strict-tower chain isomorphism $\alpha:T(P,Q[r])\xrightarrow{\sim}T(P,Q)[r]$, define integralCompletedTensorFiniteShiftFormula to require the following for every quotient level $n$, every $i,j\in\mathbf Z$, every object $U$ of the small pro-etale site, $x\in P_n^i(U)$ and $y\in Q_n^{j+r}(U)$. The degree-$(i+j)$ component of $\alpha_n$ sends the $(i,j)$ total-tensor generator of $x\otimes y$ in $T_n(P,Q[r])$ to the inverse canonical reindexing of $(-1)^{ri}$ times the $(i,j+r)$ total-tensor generator of $x\otimes y$ in $T_n(P,Q)^{i+j+r}$. Transition compatibility belongs to the supplied strict-tower isomorphism itself. This defines only its signed generator formula, with no existence claim, no flatness or K-flatness hypothesis, and no derived-limit identification. The scheme and coefficient universes are independent.
